page_notes.600: T-Slot Insert Linear Bearing Pad (7-46): 15-series 6897 and 6898 extracted with UHMW PE/Extruded/Smooth specs and suggested hardware 3628 (2x #10 x 5/8” Bearing Pad Screw); 10-series 6797/6798, metric rows and hardware 3625/25-3625/40-3628 skipped.
page_notes.601: Single-Keyed UniBearing™ Pad (7-47): 15-series 6814 (White) and 6817 (Black) extracted; included hardware 3650 (badged 15 + 40) attached; 10-series 6705/6706, metric rows and 3649 skipped.
page_notes.602: Double-Keyed UniBearing™ Pad (7-48): 15-series 6892 (White) and 6893 (Black) extracted; included hardware for 15 series (2x 206701 bolt, 1x 3263 T-nut) attached; 10-series 6792/6793 and metric rows skipped.
page_notes.603: Single-Keyed Standard Bearing Pad Profile (7-49): 15-series 6810 (Natural) and 6811 (Black) extracted; Cut to Length required machining (pg. 11-2) has no service number or series badge, so it is recorded in notes only.
page_notes.604: Double-Keyed Standard Bearing Pad Profile (7-50): 15-series 6812 (Natural) and 6813 (Black) extracted; Cut to Length required machining (pg. 11-2) recorded in notes; 10-series and metric rows skipped.
page_notes.605: Linear Bearing Shim Stock (7-51): 15-series 6881 and 6882 extracted (Mylar, Stamped, Clear, packs of 10); 10-series 6780/6782 and metric rows skipped.
page_notes.606: “L” Handle Linear Bearing Brake Kit (7-52): 15-series 6800 Gray, 6805 Blue, 6806 Red, 6807 Yellow extracted; 10-series 6850 and metric rows (including 45-6800 with drop-in t-nut 13173) skipped.
page_notes.607: “T” Handle (6801) and Star Handle (6802) Linear Bearing Brake Kits (7-53): both 15-series rows extracted; metric 40-6801 and 40-6802 skipped.
